rankings.summaryHtml: The Sixers haven't won two in a row since a 3-0 finish to November, but their rout of the Knicks launched an eight-game homestand. Jrue Holiday's 35-point eruption in the rout halted Philly's NBA-high run of 436 straight games without a 35-point scorer since Willie Green back in April 2007.
